entities.summary: Karpoori Devi was an Indian folk artist, known for painting in the Madhubani art tradition and creating textile art in the Sujni tradition. who achieved both critical and commercial success by selling Madhubani art. Her work is archived in collections in India, as well as in Japan, Australia, and the United States.
